name: Hybrid Temporal Legal Drift Score (TLDS); TLDP is the same value read as a percentage
formula: D = 100 × (w_T·T + w_S·S + w_L·L + w_R·R), every component in [0, 1]
weights_rationale: Research parameters, not established constants. Legal effect carries the most weight because the research question is about legally applicable change; T and S both measure wording (S is a word-overlap stand-in, see semantic), so together they are capped at half; rule structure is a coarse count and gets the least. Alternative weights can be passed to tlds() and are compared in reports/fingerprint/tlds_heldout.v1.json.

components.textual: token-level Levenshtein distance between the normalised clauses ÷ the longer clause's token count
components.semantic: 1 − cosine of the configured embedding of each normalised clause; the default is the retriever's deterministic 256-dimension feature-hash vector, a word-overlap stand-in, NOT a pretrained semantic model
components.legal_effect: the most severe detected rule-field change, scored with legal_effect_rubric
components.rule_structure: share of the clause's distinct rule elements (field values, list items keyed by content, Explanations, cross-references) inserted, deleted or substituted; a removed and an added element of the same kind count as one substitution: (only-before + only-after − substitutions) ÷ (all distinct − substitutions)

levels.0.50: Material change to a condition, procedure or scope
levels.0.75: Substantial change to an obligation, entitlement or restriction

legal_effect_rubric.aggregation: maximum over detected changes: the composite reflects the most severe change once, and every change is listed with its spans
legal_effect_rubric.reversal: a modality change that removes an obligation or permission and adds a prohibition in the same aligned sentences, or the reverse

missing: A component that cannot be computed is null with a reason, never 0. The score is COMPLETE only when all four exist; otherwise INCOMPLETE with value null and a separately named partial_value = 100 × Σ_available w_i·x_i ÷ Σ_available w_i that must not be compared with complete scores.
bands_note: Provisional lower bounds applied to the score rounded to one decimal; not empirically validated.
note: An indicator of change between two versions of one clause, not the percentage of a statute that changed, not legal correctness, not a probability, not materiality and not risk. Read legal-effect drift beside it: a small wording change can carry a large legal effect.
